goal: ONE detailed paragraph. What to change and WHY. The invariants that must NOT break. What 'done' looks like (observable). If a completed example exists to mirror, name it and say 'mirror its structure'.
conventions: Coding conventions the reviewer judges against: language/version constraints, what stays additive, style, and what NOT to touch (legacy business logic).

gates.build: SHELL COMMAND that compiles/lints — a non-zero exit code means FAIL (this gate must ALWAYS pass)
gates.test: SHELL COMMAND that runs the test suite
gates.testSetup: Notes for authoring + running tests: how to scope a single test (path or filter), any test-runner quirks, run-as-user / container exec prefix, fixtures/DB isolation.

baselineNote: Describe any EXPECTED pre-existing working-tree changes (e.g. a local config patch) so they are folded into the staged baseline rather than treated as task work. Omit if the tree is clean.
